details: Escalating geopolitical tensions between the United States and Iran have fueled a "risk-off" sentiment across global financial markets, leading to a notable decline in cryptocurrency values. Bitcoin slipped below $63,000, with other altcoins also experiencing corrections. This renewed hostility, coupled with concerns about potential oil supply disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz, is driving investors towards safer assets.
title: US-Iran Tensions Escalate, Bitcoin Dips Amid Risk-Off Sentiment

details: Former President Trump's recent allegations accusing China of a significant compromise of election data have introduced fresh geopolitical uncertainty, further unsettling global markets. This development, alongside existing US-Iran tensions, has contributed to a broader "risk-off" reaction, causing Bitcoin to slide below $63,000 as investors exercise caution ahead of a planned summit between US and Chinese leaders.
title: Trump's China Election Data Allegations Add to Geopolitical Uncertainty
